drafts.title: Allow Once
drafts.pitch: Every file Cursor wants to read needs the user's permission, one click at a time; Tilde: "Forty onces. That's practically always."
drafts.reason: Sharp, relatable closer, but a generic agent-permissions gag with little use of the stop door, handset or Judge.

drafts.title: Same Room
drafts.pitch: Cursor paints a new door on the wall for a fresh chat, and every door opens on the same room. From Kurkur's comment on 015-same-website (issue #34).
drafts.reason: On theme but muddled: the smaller duplicate characters and the visiting agent blur the logic, and 'Same room' is flat and repeats the title.
